plugin_desc: A10 Thunder/AX ADC SNMP child template for devices whose sysObjectID is under 1.3.6.1.4.1.22610. In addition to the shared Loadbalance SNMP IF-MIB floor, it collects A10-AX-MIB scalars: average CPU percent (axSysAverageCpuUsage) and system memory total/used in KB (axSysMemoryTotal / axSysMemoryUsage; utilization computed as used/total). Current-connection and temperature/fan/power leaves are N/A. Supported brands/models - A10 Thunder ADC / AX series (physical and vThunder).
name: Loadbalance

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: Average CPU utilization of the A10 Thunder/AX appliance (A10-AX-MIB axSysAverageCpuUsage, last 5 seconds, 0-100 percent). Sustained high CPU means the ADC is near its processing capacity.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total system memory of the A10 Thunder/AX appliance in bytes (A10-AX-MIB axSysMemoryTotal, reported in KB and scaled to bytes).

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Used system memory of the A10 Thunder/AX appliance in bytes (A10-AX-MIB axSysMemoryUsage, reported in KB used and scaled to bytes).

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: System memory utilization of the A10 Thunder/AX appliance, computed as used/total*100 (A10-AX-MIB axSysMemoryUsage / axSysMemoryTotal).
